hints.title: Zero Annihilation
hints.text: If zero appears anywhere in nums, the product of the entire array is 0 <= k, allowing the array to collapse to length 1.

hints.title: Greedy Product Accumulation
hints.text: Merge adjacent elements into running product y so long as y * x <= k.

hints.title: New Block Threshold
hints.text: Whenever y * x exceeds k, start a new element block initialized to x and increment the array length counter.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all parenthesizations of products takes Catalan number of evaluations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that greedy adjacent multiplication is optimal and zero allows instant collapse to 1.
